_doc: check-migration-grants.mjs --all: exact two-way baseline (Q263, 2026-09-23). Every entry here is a function `--all` still finds no GRANT/REVOKE (static or dynamic) for in the migration history — a genuine open question this script cannot answer from source, since a Supabase-advisor pass has repeatedly stripped the default PUBLIC EXECUTE (the #355/#358/#364/#366 saga). Each needs a LIVE check: SELECT proacl FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = '<name>' AND pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace (no prod access in the session that built this baseline). May only SHRINK — remove an entry once its grant is confirmed live (or added explicitly), and a name check-migration-grants.mjs no longer flags must be removed here or the check fails as stale. 12 distinct functions across 15 migration@name pairs (a later migration's CREATE OR REPLACE re-flags the same never-granted name).
